en: Black-and-white postcard showing an ornate Renaissance-style arcade with a long row of arches supported by columns and richly decorated friezes above. Behind and to the left rises a more massive building with steep roofs and dormers, and in the background a tall baroque church tower with a bulbous dome. The scene is an open courtyard or square with metal railings and bollards in the foreground. No printed captions or text are visible on the image side.
